[package]
name = "anime-game-core"
version = "1.39.3"
authors = ["Nikita Podvirnyi <krypt0nn@vk.com>"]
license = "GPL-3.0"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/an-anime-team/anime-game-core"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[dependencies]
dns-lookup = "2.0"
serde_json = "1.0"
fs_extra = "1.3.0"
thiserror = "1.0"
tracing = "0.1"
lazy_static = "1.5.0"

[dependencies.minreq]
version = "2.13"
features = ["json-using-serde", "https-rustls-probe", "proxy"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.cached]
version = "0.55"
features = ["proc_macro"]

[dependencies.anyhow]
version = "1.0"
features = ["backtrace"]

[dependencies.sysinfo]
version = "0.35"
optional = true
features = ["linux-netdevs"]

[dependencies.zip]
version = "3.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.tar]
version = "0.4"
optional = true

[dependencies.xz]
version = "0.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.bzip2]
version = "0.4"
optional = true

[dependencies.flate2]
version = "1.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.md-5]
version = "0.10"
features = ["asm"]
optional = true

[dependencies.kinda-virtual-fs]
version = "0.1.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.sophon]
git = "https://github.com/dawn-winery/sophon-tools.git"
tag = "v0.1.9"
package = "sophon-lib"
optional = true

[features]
genshin = ["sophon"]
star-rail = ["sophon"]
zzz = []
honkai = ["sophon"]
sophon = ["dep:sophon"]
install = ["external", "dep:sysinfo", "dep:zip", "dep:tar", "dep:xz", "dep:bzip2", "dep:flate2", "dep:md-5"]
external = ["dep:kinda-virtual-fs"]
patches = []
patch-jadeite = []
patch-mfc140 = []
all = ["install", "external", "patches"]

[build-dependencies.protobuf-codegen]
version = "3.7.2"
optional = true

[package]
name = "anime-launcher-sdk"
version = "1.36.7"
authors = ["Nikita Podvirnyi <krypt0nn@vk.com>"]
license = "GPL-3.0"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/an-anime-team/anime-launcher-sdk"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[dependencies]
tracing = "0.1"

[dependencies.anime-game-core]
git = "https://github.com/an-anime-team/anime-game-core"
tag = "1.39.3"
features = ["all"]

[dependencies.anyhow]
version = "1.0"
features = ["backtrace"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
features = ["derive"]
optional = true

[dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.cached]
version = "0.55"
features = ["proc_macro"]

[dependencies.enum-ordinalize]
version = "4.3"
optional = true

[dependencies.wincompatlib]
version = "0.7.7"
features = ["dxvk"]
optional = true

[dependencies.lazy_static]
version = "1.5.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.md-5]
version = "0.10"
features = ["asm"]
optional = true

[features]
genshin = ["anime-game-core/genshin"]
star-rail = ["anime-game-core/star-rail"]
zzz = ["anime-game-core/zzz"]
honkai = ["anime-game-core/honkai"]
star-rail-patch = ["anime-game-core/patch-jadeite", "anime-game-core/patch-mfc140"]
states = []
config = ["dep:serde", "dep:serde_json", "dep:enum-ordinalize"]
components = ["dep:wincompatlib", "dep:lazy_static"]
game = ["components", "config"]
sandbox = []
sessions = []
environment-emulation = []
fps-unlocker = ["dep:md-5"]
all = ["states", "config", "components", "game", "sandbox", "sessions", "environment-emulation", "fps-unlocker"]
default = ["all"]

[package]
name = "sophon-lib"
version = "0.1.9"
edition = "2024"
license = "GPL-3.0-or-later"
rust-version = "1.94.1"

[features]
default = ["vendored-hpatchz"]
vendored-hpatchz = []
paimon = ["dep:paimon"]
extra-logs = []

[dependencies]
thiserror = "2.0.16"
md-5 = "0.10.6"
tracing = "0.1.41"
fs2 = "0.4.3"
crossbeam-channel = "0.5.15"
bytes = "1.11.0"
fs_extra = "1.3.0"
prost = "0.14.3"
interprocess = "2.4.0"
rand = "0.10.0"

[dependencies.zstd]
version = "0.13"

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.12"
features = ["blocking", "h2", "http2", "json", "rustls-tls", "rustls-tls-webpki-roots", "socks"]
default-features = false

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.219"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.paimon]
git = "https://dawn.wine/lily/paimon"
version = "0.1.0"
optional = true

[build-dependencies]
md-5 = "0.10.6"
prost-build = "0.14.3"

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/an-anime-team/anime-game-core"]
git = "https://github.com/an-anime-team/anime-game-core"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "1.39.3"

[source."https://github.com/an-anime-team/anime-launcher-sdk"]
git = "https://github.com/an-anime-team/anime-launcher-sdk"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "1.36.7"

[source."https://github.com/dawn-winery/sophon-tools"]
git = "https://github.com/dawn-winery/sophon-tools"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v0.1.9"
